title: Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning for Dual-Use Concepts in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility. In these dual-use domains, legitimate defensive science and malicious attacks share vocabulary, syntax, and internal model representations, causing standard unlearning methods to induce severe collateral damage (concept bleeding).   In this work, we present Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework designed to eliminate collateral damage on benign dual-use capabilities. OBU extracts a domain-matched capability subspace from paired calibration queries via singular value decomposition on empirical activation covariances, and restricts parameter updates strictly to the orthogonal null space. translated_title: 大语言模型中双用途概念的正交边界遗忘
translated_abstract: 减轻大语言模型的灾难性风险需要在剔除危险作战能力（如网络战攻击利用和病原体增强）的同时，不损害其良性的科学实用性。在这些双用途领域中，合法的防御科学与恶意攻击共享相同的词汇、语法和内部模型表示，导致标准遗忘方法会产生严重的附带损害（概念渗透）。在这项工作中，我们提出了正交边界遗忘，这是一个具有数学理论基础的框架，旨在消除对良性双用途能力的附带损害。OBU通过对经验激活协方差进行奇异值分解，从配对的校准查询中提取领域匹配的能力子空间，并将参数更新严格限制在正交零空间内。这保证了良性表示在所张成的校准子空间方向上经历零参数扰动……
tldr: 提出正交边界遗忘（OBU）框架，通过将参数更新严格限制在与能力子空间正交的零空间内，在剔除大语言模型危险双用途能力（如网络战、病原体增强）的同时，保证对良性科学能力造成零附带损害。
en_tdlr: Proposes Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework that restricts parameter updates to the orthogonal null space, excising hazardous dual-use capabilities in LLMs (e.g., cyberwarfare, pathogen enhancement) while guaranteeing zero collateral damage to benign scientific capabilities.
